external/venue-and-hardware.txt

WHAT THIS IS
  What the demo needs physically at our table, and the venue rules that affect it.

WHO / WHEN
  D: check on Saturday morning, set up on Sunday by 8 AM.

THE TABLE NEEDS
  - An external monitor and its cable (HDMI or USB-C) for the big screen, with the dashboard in
    ?big mode. A big screen also makes the table easy to spot.
  - A power strip or extension cord: 3-4 laptops stay plugged in for two hours of judging.
  - Laptops A, B and C for the agents, plus the watcher machine (it can be D's laptop driving the monitor).
  - Chargers, and a mouse for D.

NETWORK
  - Venue Wi-Fi only. The network name and password are in the Hacker Guide (p.26).
  - Personal hotspots, routers and anything that interferes with the wireless network are NOT
    allowed (Guide p.6). Phone tethering is not a backup.
  - The backup is the recorded demo video, stored on the laptop that drives the monitor.
  - SpacetimeDB maincloud and GitHub both need the internet. Rehearse once on the venue Wi-Fi on
    Saturday night and write down the times in demo-app/SCENARIO.md.

VENUE
  Palace of Fine Arts, San Francisco. There is no hacker parking. Sleeping areas and showers are on site.
